title: Phase 1 Payload — Ingestion & Prioritization
description: Payload when phase=1, status=ok (FR-008..FR-010, FR-036). Issues bearing the no-automation label are excluded from selection (FR-037).

ranked_issue_ids.description: Implementable issues, highest to lowest priority. Empty (with a justification noting 'all held / no work') when every candidate carries no-automation or the backlog is empty.

top_choice_justification.description: Why the #1 issue was chosen; MUST state the unblock-vs-severity trade-off explicitly when an unblocking issue out-ranks a higher-severity isolated one (FR-009). Notes severity_source used (FR-036).

dependency_notes.description: Maps each issue to the issues it blocks. Empty array when no dependencies.
